rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides AI assistants with secure code execution capabilities across 7 programming languages (Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Ruby, Bash, Zsh, Fish) through Docker containerization with strict security controls. Built using Ruby 3.4 with Alpine Linux for minimal attack surface, the implementation features multi-stage Docker builds, real-time output streaming, syntax validation tools, and comprehensive security measures including read-only filesystems, network isolation, resource limits, and non-root execution. Serves developers needing safe code execution environments for AI workflows, educational platforms requiring sandboxed programming environments, and teams building AI-powered development tools that need reliable code execution with proper isolation and security controls.
